verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights or suggestions about a user's entity data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only conventional search, filing wizards, certificates and email reminders, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions of any kind. The probes also found no llms.txt or API, which confirms the absence of AI-facing features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
